rig.sides: anatomical; left is on viewer's right in the rest pose
rig.coordinates: integer pixels in the shared 768x640 canvas
rig.composition: source-over by ascending z, place every layer at (0,0) in rest pose
rig.pivotApplication: rotate around each pivot in rest canvas coordinates; propagate parent transforms down the tree

core.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Independent 2D game skeletal sprite pieces on a completely transparent RGBA canvas. Use the attached female game character as exact visual identity reference. Keep the same chibi proportions, saturated color palette, large detailed eyes and facial features, costume fabrics, bold ink contours, fine cel shading, frontal slightly elevated 3/4 view. One standalone painted opaque part centered in each specified invisible cell, generous clear margins. Add short hidden overlaps for sewing the joints, no labels, no grid, no backdrops, no floating border, no shadow. Anatomical left is viewer right. Square 2x2 atlas. Top left head and entire green hood lining exactly matching the character, amber brown eyes, warm auburn hair center part, short face-framing strands only, NO long braid (draw that separately in other sheet), tiny neck stub. Top right independent forest green cape narrow behind neck and flared out. Bottom left torso alone, warm brown leather armor with diagonal chest strap, dark brass rectangular buckle, moss green short tunic and closed shoulder edges. Bottom right independent brown back quiver visibly stuffed with multiple green-fletched arrows, tilted diagonally upper-left with a visible shaft case. No bow.
